qt: to the Commission Özlem Demirel (The Left) Subject:

Frontex uses various satellite services for migration control in the framework of the European Border Surveillance System Eurosur. Member States may request the use of such services. An additional purpose is to fight cross-border crime. 1.

How many requests from agencies/EU Member States did the Frontex-based Eurosur Fusion Services receive from Member States in 2022, 2023 and 2024 in relation to the ‘smuggling of migrants’, and in how many cases were satellite services subsequently provided?
In how many cases have Eurosur Fusion Services requested the use of commercial satellite services for this purpose and what is their resolution?
From which companies were these satellite services acquired and what costs were incurred in 2022, 2023 and 2024?
at: (English version) to the Commission Özlem Demirel (The Left) (24 April 2024) Subject: Frontex satellite services for EU Member States Frontex uses various satellite services for migration control in the framework of the European Border Surveillance System Eurosur. Member States may request the use of such services. An additional purpose is to fight cross-border crime. 1. How many requests from agencies/EU Member States did the Frontex-based Eurosur Fusion Services receive from Member States in 2022, 2023 and 2024 in relation to the ‘smuggling of migrants’, and in how many cases were satellite services subsequently provided? 2. In how many cases have Eurosur Fusion Services requested the use of commercial satellite services for this purpose and what is their resolution? 3.
From which companies were these satellite services acquired and what costs were incurred in 2022, 2023 and 2024?

(19 June 2024) As the question regarding ‘Frontex satellite services for EU Member States’ falls entirely under the responsibility of the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex), the Commission has asked the Agency to provide the details requested by the Honourable Member. The Agency’s reply will be sent by the Commission to the Honourable Member as soon as possible. See annexes: Annex 1, Annex 2, Annex 3.
